Allergies — FHIR Questionnaire Template

'No known allergies' plus a repeatable list of allergens with reaction and severity.

Scoring

No scoring — a data-collection fragment.

Questions

  1. No known allergies
  2. Allergen (medication, food or other)
  3. Reaction
  4. Severity
    • Mild
    • Moderate
    • Severe

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open the Builder, choose + Add → From template…, search for “Allergies” and insert it. It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
